global_algorithmic_rule: Algorithm constructors receive only target integer N, an independent seed/public parameter s, and fixed public constants. Hidden factors p,q and any value derived by first resolving p,q are proof/verifier data only.
proof_side_rule: CRT decompositions, p-adic valuations and local prime-labelled projections may be used in proofs after the N-native object is defined, but may not be used to choose, initialize, truncate, phase-select, coordinate-select or tune that object.

allowed_inputs: packet/path counts on an N-native public carrier
prime-wall/filament predicates only when their full construction cost is charged
forbidden: cell witness (a,b) satisfying H=N(a,b)C(a,b) for target H
nontrivial idempotent e supplied or selected after factor knowledge
BRC truncation length p when p is a hidden factor
RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-BLIND-BENCHMARK-SU.required_cost_accounting: Separate poly(n) per-seed arithmetic from number of seeds/support size; value-polynomial scans are ENUMERATIVE.

RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-HIDDEN-FACTOR-SEPA.priority_attack: Measure whether any admitted N-native component biases public seeds toward different local behavior beyond the fixed-degree O(1/p+1/q) baseline.

allowed_reuse: public kernel A_n and exact integer recurrences independent of hidden factors
proof-side local p/q analysis after an N-native residue is defined
not_admitted_as_constructor: inert-prime finite Clausen object indexed by hidden p
RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-BLIND-PADIC-GCD-BR.required_first_step: Define G_N(s) or a finite list of residues using only N,s with no p-sized hidden-factor truncation. Prove denominator validity over Z/NZ before local analysis.
RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-BLIND-PADIC-GCD-BR.success_gate: integer residue/determinant whose gcd with N is nontrivial on an explicit family or with quantified factor-blind seed success.

allowed_reuse: exact M_m/table formulas with public m
RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-CRITICAL-COFACTOR-.required_first_step: Define m=m(N,s) or another N-native coordinate map and a support set F_N without reading divisors.
RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-CRITICAL-COFACTOR-.success_gate: divisor coverage plus explicit support cardinality/construction bit-cost; merely re-expressing divisor enumeration is ENUMERATIVE.

allowed_reuse: universal quotient/module definitions functorial in base ring
T5/T6/T11 only as proof-side decoder targets
H=91 regression guard as verification only
forbidden_as_algorithmic_input: cell coordinates (a,b) tied to target H
RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-PRIME-FUSION-NBLIN.exact_boundary: A nontrivial idempotent is polynomial-time equivalent to a coprime factor split, so an N-native task must GENERATE it (or an equivalent asymmetry), not assume it.
RS-PRIME-COORD-FACTOR-PRIME-FUSION-NBLIN.priority_attack: Construct M_N,T_N from N only and seek rank/orbit/determinant/annihilator asymmetry. Arbitrary-seed polynomial gcd probes are baseline and square-root-scale unless the dynamics provably biases them.
